messages:
annie: Heads-up — hit a pretty odd generation drift when loading MistralX weights via the llama-compat loader. Short repro below, filing here before I open a formal ticket.

mike: can you paste the model/config snippet and a tiny example output?

annie: snippet:```python
# loaded model config that caused the issue
n_heads = 64
hidden_size = 4096
head_dim = 64  # expected
rotary_dim = 32  # mismatch here compared to head_dim
rope_scaling = { 'alpha': 1.0 }
```

annie: repro behavior: generate with long context (~3k tokens) — model repeats short phrases and token probabilities collapse on certain vocab ids. Happens in fp32 before any quant.

raj: rotary_dim != head_dim can be legitimate for headwise implementations, but our loader currently assumes rotary_dim == head_dim for direct memcpy of sincos tables.

annie: yep — I dug in and found the sin/cos table sizing code trims to head_dim and we end up reusing sincos rows for multiple heads. Also noticed tokenizer token id aliasing for <pad>/<sentinel> in the converted vocab mapping.

sophia: did you run the kv-cache alignment smoke? I recall similar symptoms if k/v layout ordering differs across model families.

annie: ran align test:```
FAIL kv-cache-align L1=0.0017 context=3072
expected kv slice for head0 != backend-loader slice
```

mike: another angle — some Gemma/Mistral variants use interleaved head layout (head-major vs head-consecutive). If loader assumes one layout you get per-head attention mixing. Try permuting the weight reshape: reshape(..., heads, head_dim) then transpose to match expected ordering.

annie: I tried a head-permute hack (transpose axes (2,1,0) style) — repetition reduced but generation still off: ppl shifted by ~0.7 on causal-lm eval. So there's more than ordering.

raj: check rope scaling/frequency too. A half-sized rotary (rotary_dim < head_dim) requires broadcasting semantics; if we accidentally tile vs pad you'll get phase aliasing. Also token-id mapping bug could map rare tokens into common-token indices causing freq spikes.

sophia: FYI pushed a small compatibility helper to convert_head_order + normalize_rotary in PR #4823. @annie can you run your repro against that branch?

ci-bot: build #4823 started — unit tests (token-mapping, kv-cache, rope) queued. :gear:

annie: will run it now, then follow up with an int8 quant smoke. Note: float32 already failing so quant is secondary but good to validate.

mike: if you can attach a tiny repro (config + two inputs) I'll run cross-model attention-heatmaps between Llama / Mistral / Gemma to isolate whether attention pruning or tokenmapping is dominant.

annie: uploading small repro files to the thread — includes failing outputs and attention logits. Thanks all, will post results in ~30m. :pray:
